result.summary: Found 3 issues related to content truncation and layout on this food delivery app screen.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontally scrollable cards show enough padding so partially visible items indicate scrollability without truncating text awkwardly, or truncate with ellipsis fully within the card boundary.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off with no restaurant name or details visible, giving an incomplete impression at the fold.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for scrollable content, but consider adjusting spacing so the next card either shows more context or less, avoiding an ambiguous half-visible state.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen card is white/outlined on a light area while the pizza card's heart is on a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency between the two favorite buttons.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon treatment (background, color, contrast) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
